subject.title: runWithModelFallback shares one abortSignal/deadline across all fallback attempts, mislabeling instant failures as provider timeouts

question: Should fallback attempts remain constrained by one caller-wide deadline, with a distinct exhausted-deadline result, or should the product grant each attempt a separately bounded retry budget?
rationale: Both approaches change observable timeout and latency semantics; source-level confirmation alone cannot decide the intended caller deadline contract.

options.title: Keep one total caller budget
options.body: Preserve the caller deadline across attempts, stop before dispatching an already-expired attempt, and report one deadline-exhausted outcome rather than provider-specific timeouts.

options.title: Add bounded attempt budgets
options.body: Allocate an explicit per-attempt budget capped by the remaining caller deadline, with documented total-time behavior and focused regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep one total caller budget
recommendation.body: Preserve the caller deadline across attempts, stop before dispatching an already-expired attempt, and report one deadline-exhausted outcome rather than provider-specific timeouts.
